inputs.text: [serious] It was a lone hunter. It caught the big plant-eaters of its time, [confident] with two long saber teeth, [amazed] as long as your hand.
[scared] Two teeth as long as my hand?
[gently] As long as your hand, yes — real weapons. But don't worry, [warmly] that was two hundred sixty million years ago: no Gorgonops left today.
